theme: An open Saturday with a clear runway
greeting: The whole day is yours, Dan — nothing is on the calendar from now until tomorrow's review. A good window to finally clear the travel bookings that have been waiting.

needsAttention.title: Sunday board review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: The weekly 15-minute review opens tomorrow at 9. Worth a pass through the board in 'Dan & Mike Stuff' tonight so everything has an owner and a date before you two sit down.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The p1 'book this week' task has slipped over a month. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — a refundable hold now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive window ends Oct 18
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 off-week gap to drive the Pathfinder Portland to St Pete closes tomorrow. After this the car can't reach Florida before Christmas without adding a flight.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The book-by date of Oct 15 has passed on the three-week December trip for all four kids. Holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year, so each day of delay narrows the field.

flagged.title: Two Brunswick Group intro calls
flagged.detail: Teams invites arrived for meetings with Christian Buss and Jonathan Doorley at Brunswick — worth confirming and prepping, given the board and public-affairs track.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley account funding
flagged.detail: A 'final reminder' to fund the new Signature Savings account — check the real deadline before it lapses.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and travel confirmations — FT, Airbnb and Kiwi bookings, language-app promos.

recipe.title: Pork chops with roasted beets & escarole salad
recipe.why: Deep autumn on the coast — roasted beets and bitter escarole are exactly what the markets are turning out now, and a seared pork chop is an easy, satisfying anchor for a mid-October evening.

acts.line: A clear morning — nothing is scheduled.
The day stays open; no meetings land at all.
A quiet evening before the week restarts tomorrow.
